data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, ivory fitted cashmere turtleneck sweater, black high-waist front-slit maxi skirt, thin leather belt, pointed black low-heel pumps, one hand in skirt pocket, holding exhibition pamphlet in other hand, turning head calmly toward viewer, subtle poised smile, minimalist modern art gallery, tall white walls, large abstract oil canvas, focused ceiling track spotlights, glossy concrete floor reflections, negative space, full body
data.animaCaption: Standing amid the serene negative space of a minimalist white gallery in an ivory cashmere turtleneck and black high-waist maxi skirt, she holds an exhibition pamphlet and turns calmly to share a dry remark. Overhead track spotlights cast crisp sculptural pools of light across the polished concrete floor.
data.promptProse: Composed with generous architectural breathing room inside a quiet contemporary art museum, Shiki Natsume pauses before a monumental framed canvas wearing a sleek ivory cashmere turtleneck tucked into a high-waisted black slit maxi skirt with a thin leather belt and low pointed pumps. Resting one hand lightly at her pocket and holding a folded gallery brochure in the other, she turns her head toward the viewer with cool, composed poise as crisp ceiling spotlights illuminate the white walls and cast subtle reflections across the smooth grey concrete floor.
data.story: 空旷的美术馆展厅安静得能听见鞋跟轻叩地面的回声。穿着米白羊绒衫配黑色长裙的夏目停在大幅油画前，翻着导览册回头望你一眼，语气平淡却带着兴致——「这幅画的留白处理得不错……别光顾着点头，待会儿考你感想。」
